points.description: States TRUE (the process may not be scheduled immediately after the interrupt handler completes).
Justification gives the cause precisely: the process's time slice (time quantum) expires/ends while the OS is handling the interrupt.
Justification gives the consequence precisely: after the interrupt handler completes, the scheduler may select a different process to run instead of the interrupted (previous) process.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that names both the time slice ending during interrupt handling and a different process being scheduled afterwards. A TRUE with no justification, or a generic one such as 'the scheduler decides' or 'higher priority process may run' without the time slice reason, earns no marks (justification is required). Wrong or contradictory statements in a point cost that point. Total is 2 marks.
